name: HAQ Login Signup
author: Husain Ahmed

sections.description:
HAQ Login Signup replaces the plain default WordPress login experience with beautiful, branded front-end login and registration forms you can place anywhere using shortcodes.

Whether you run a membership site, online course, community, SaaS landing page, or business website, this plugin helps you create a polished first impression at the exact moment users sign in or join.

Why choose HAQ Login Signup?

  • Premium UI out of the box — 10 ready-made templates (classic, split, minimal, glass, bordered, dark, editorial, soft, compact, floating)
  • Brand in minutes — change colors, fonts, button style, and logo from the admin settings panel
  • Shortcode powered — drop [haq_login] or [haq_signup] on any page, post, or builder block
  • Per-page design control — override the template with attributes like [haq_login template="dark"]
  • Custom registration fields — collect phone, company, dropdown choices, checkboxes, and more (saved to user meta)
  • Better user experience — responsive layouts, password show/hide, remember me, and clear validation messages
  • Smart redirects — send users to a dashboard, account page, or thank-you URL after login/signup
  • Built for modern WordPress — uses current authentication APIs, nonces, and secure coding practices
  • Admin + user emails — registration notifications for a smoother onboarding flow

Perfect for

  • Membership and community websites
  • Course / LMS registration pages
  • Client portals and service businesses
  • Startup and SaaS product sites
  • Any WordPress site that wants a branded login/signup experience

How it works

  1. Activate the plugin
  2. Open Settings → HAQ Login Signup
  3. Choose your default template and brand colors
  4. Create a Login page and Signup page
  5. Paste [haq_login] and [haq_signup]
  6. Enable Settings → General → Anyone can register for signup

Shortcodes

Login

  • [haq_login]
  • [haq_login template="split"]
  • Alias examples: [haq_login_classic], [haq_login_dark], [haq_login_glass]

Signup

  • [haq_signup]
  • [haq_signup template="soft"]
  • Alias examples: [haq_signup_classic], [haq_signup_split], [haq_signup_floating]

Available templates: classic, split, minimal, glass, bordered, dark, editorial, soft, compact, floating

Each template includes both a login layout and a signup layout.

What you can customize

  • Default template for the whole site
  • Primary / secondary / text / background / button colors
  • Font family (system fonts or custom CSS stack)
  • Button style: solid, outline, or soft
  • Logo upload for form headers
  • Login and signup redirect URLs
  • Extra signup fields with labels, types, required rules, and options

Need custom work? (24-hour response)

Want this plugin customized for your brand, theme, or special business flow?

I can help with:

  • Custom template design matching your website
  • Extra fields and validation rules
  • Redirect / membership / role setup
  • Integration with your existing theme or page builder
  • Any login/signup related customization

Email me directly: husain.ahmed25@gmail.com

I typically reply and start your requested work within 24 hours, based on your requirements.

Support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New
  2. Activate HAQ Login Signup from the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → HAQ Login Signup and choose a template, colors, logo, and redirects
  4. Create pages for Login and Signup, then add [haq_login] and [haq_signup]
  5. For registration, enable Settings → General → Anyone can register
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. HAQ Login Signup is free to download and use. If you need custom design or advanced changes, you can email husain.ahmed25@gmail.com for paid customization.

How do I choose a template per page?

Add the template attribute, for example: [haq_login template="dark"] or [haq_signup template="glass"].

Why is the signup form not registering users?

Enable membership registration under Settings → General → Anyone can register.

Where do I find all shortcodes?

Open Settings → HAQ Login Signup. Every template lists its login and signup shortcodes, including alias shortcodes.

Can I add custom fields to signup?

Yes. Under Extra Registration Fields you can add text, email, phone, URL, number, textarea, dropdown, and checkbox fields. Values are saved to user meta and shown on the user profile in admin.

Will it work with page builders?

Yes. Place the shortcodes inside Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, or any builder that supports shortcodes.

Can you customize this for my website?

Yes. Email husain.ahmed25@gmail.com with your requirement. I aim to respond and deliver customization work within 24 hours according to your needs.
sections.changelog:
3.1.0 – 2026-11-07

  • Improved WordPress.org plugin page content with premium-style description and benefits
  • Added customization / support contact details for direct email requests
  • Updated plugin assets (banner and screenshots) for a clearer product presentation
  • Confirmed compatibility metadata (Tested up to WordPress 7.1)

3.0.0 – 2026-11-07

Release notes — major redesign

This release rebuilds HAQ Login Signup around selectable UI templates and a full settings panel.

  • Added 10 UI templates for both login and signup: classic, split, minimal, glass, bordered, dark, editorial, soft, compact, floating
  • Added Settings → HAQ Login Signup admin screen for default template, colors, fonts, button style, logo, and redirects
  • Added shortcode template attribute and per-template alias shortcodes ([haq_login_split], [haq_signup_soft], and more)
  • Added optional extra registration fields saved to user meta and shown on the user profile
  • Rebuilt authentication handlers on modern WordPress login and registration APIs
  • Added password show/hide control and responsive form layouts
  • Fixed registration nonce mismatch that could block new signups
  • Fixed deprecated authentication cookie handling for current WordPress versions

2.0

  • Previous monolithic shortcode forms for login and signup

1.0.0

  • First public release
